description: Display ad response rate for a marketplace over a period, broken down by page type (SEARCH, CATEGORY, PRODUCT, HOME, ...). Returns raw ad requests, responses, and response rate (%) per page_type from the display filtered-level performance facts. Pick page_type to group by; it is also filterable. No spend / no currency conversion.

page_type.description: The surface the display ad served on (SEARCH, CATEGORY, PRODUCT, HOME, ...).

requests.selector: COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN r.date BETWEEN '__START_DATE_1__' AND '__END_DATE_1__' THEN r.requests ELSE 0 END), 0)
requests.description: Display ad requests received for this page type.

responses.selector: COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN r.date BETWEEN '__START_DATE_1__' AND '__END_DATE_1__' THEN r.responses ELSE 0 END), 0)
responses.description: Display ad requests that returned at least one ad (responses) for this page type.

response_rate.selector: SAFE_DIVIDE(SUM(CASE WHEN r.date BETWEEN '__START_DATE_1__' AND '__END_DATE_1__' THEN r.responses ELSE 0 END) * 100, NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN r.date BETWEEN '__START_DATE_1__' AND '__END_DATE_1__' THEN r.requests ELSE 0 END), 0))
response_rate.description: Response rate (%) = responses / requests * 100 for this page type.

query.REPORTING: SELECT __ATTRIBUTES__, __METRICS__ FROM `prj-onlinesales-prod-01.reporting.os_display_ads_filtered_level_performance_facts` AS r JOIN `prj-onlinesales-prod-01.reporting.marketplace_clients` AS mc ON r.marketplace_client_id = mc.marketplace_client_id WHERE mc.agency_id = '__AGENCY_ID__' AND r.date BETWEEN '__START_DATE_1__' AND '__END_DATE_1__' AND r.page_type IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(r.page_type) != '' AND __FILTER__ GROUP BY __ATTRIBUTES_GROUP_BY__;
